notes.title: Xbox Gamepad Support & Collision Update
notes.notes:
The update has just been applied.

1. Xbox Pad Support (in development)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588477/6dd21929f4b39e094133bdb993070279b0ab97c1.jpg[/img]

The Xbox gamepad is now supported.
The internal test has been completed, and it is working normally.
The PlayStation gamepad also works, but this version of the game still only supports the Xbox GUI.
Playstation gamepad GUI will be supported soon.
The vibration on & off options and the aim assistant level change options are still under development.



2. Increased level visibility

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588477/15889b0814fe3ecfd40c9ce1a68c3a0cda10343f.jpg[/img]

There was an opinion that walls, floors, and stairs were difficult to distinguish.
To resolve this issue, some wall sprites and stairs sprites have been replaced.



3. Reduce character collisions
Character collisions have been reduced to 1/4 size.
There are fewer situations where characters get stuck on the wall than before.


4. Add whistling sound
Whistle sfx plays when the boomerang returns.



5. Add boomerang UI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588477/ba05dea64887cb7495e9fa5c977d5e82956041b9.jpg[/img]

The trajectory of the boomerang is displayed.



6. Change level design
Changed the structure of some levels and reduced combat difficulty.



7. Increase character lighting
The character's default circular lighting size has increased.
You can now better understand the level when the character walks or stands.



8. Fix door collision pass bug



[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42747764]9. The Steam Developer page fo Uneducated Game Studio has been created.[/url]
Click Follow to get a notification of my next game.



10. I just made a logo for the Uneducated Game Studio.
Just take a look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588477/0c19bccbac6715ed70e36e639e718105a75cdf01.png[/img]


Next Update Announcement

1. Simplified Chinese translation improvement (next week)
2. Add Traditional Chinese Translation (next week)
3. Fixing bugs


Thanks for playing!!!

notes.title: Change difficulty level naming & balance update
notes.notes:
Hello, This is Uneducated Game Studio.

Thank you to everyone who played the game.
I am planning to update the game tomorrow.



[b]1. Change the difficulty level naming.[/b]

There was a lot of feedback that the game's difficulty naming is incorrect.
The current "Normal" difficulty is horribly difficult.
I would like to apologize to the players who suffered from the wrong name
The difficulty level name will be changed as below.

Novice -> Normal
Normal -> Difficult



[b]2. Remove some obstacles.[/b]

At some levels, too many obstacles caused fatigue.
Due to the excessive walling of the character, some players could not escape and died.
I'm going to fix this phenomenon by removing some walls and obstacles that appear in the middle and second half of the game.



[b]3. Shadow removal at the end of the play[/b]

A case of wandering the road was seen on certain stages later in the game.
It was not intended, so it will be improved.

Thank you for reading it.
Some players were unable to find a way out at certain stage later in the game.
This was not the intended part and will be fixed.
This patch will not make the game perfect, but I will continue to monitor and apply updates.

[b]Thank you!!![/b]
